summary: Controls classifier-free guidance on the direct SD3.5 generation endpoint. Higher values force closer prompt adherence but can reduce variety and introduce oversaturated or brittle results; Stability documents 4.0 as the default and a 1.0 through 10.0 range.
combines: It applies to direct v2beta SD3.5 generation only. Stable Image Ultra and the reviewed Bedrock Ultra and SD3.5 request schemas do not expose this field.
A portable model control would need transport-aware availability and a numeric slider, neither of which exists in the current configuration matrix.
The provider omits the field and uses Stability's default until that separate implementation is designed.
note: Requires a transport-aware numeric-control feature; not implemented in this iteration.
